workload.shape: Laguna SWA decode, 72 query heads / 8 KV heads / D128 / BF16 KV
workload.baseline: retained exact GQA3 score producer plus local128 wave-local reducer
workload.candidate: same exact score plane plus 96-workgroup local32 reducer; each workgroup owns 32 dimensions for three adjacent query heads
workload.timing: HIP events around the complete two-kernel score plus gated-value route
workload.command: PYTHONPATH=. HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151 GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=2 .venv/bin/python3 - <<'PY' # inline allocation/append harness derived from tests/test_laguna_split_scores_gqa.py; 5 warmups + 15 alternating 200-launch HIP-event bursts at every listed live length

profile.command: HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151 GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=1 HIPENGINE_COMPILER_VERSION_FILE=/tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt HIPENGINE_REQUIRE_CACHED_BUILD=1 PYTHONPATH=. rocprofv3 --kernel-trace --output-format csv --output-directory /tmp/laguna-gqa3-local32-rejected-20260728 --output-file trace -- .venv/bin/pytest -q tests/test_laguna_split_scores_gqa.py::test_laguna_swa_split_gqa3_scores_match_exact_wave_local_at_ring_boundaries

decision.reason: The regression is present at every live length despite low VGPR and zero LDS/scratch. Serial three-head exp/FMA chains reduce active wave concurrency; V reuse cannot amortize that latency.
decision.next: Close exact grouped-value ownership and move to LD-2 exact wave-owned multi-output source-F16 GEMV.
